protocol: interoceptive_drive_v3: Block-2 minimal experiment. Asymmetric uncertainty (half hard d=0.6, half easy d=0.95); the drive is belief entropy (confidence gap from the Block-1 primitive), no external reward, no RL. Criterion: belief_drive visits hard (high-uncertainty) locations disproportionately (> hard_fraction+0.05, > random+0.1, > fixed+0.1) -- the signature of internal-state-driven epistemic foraging.
